subject: Connector maintenance clarification
body: Our team performed routine connector maintenance on 12 October. We did not plan a bulk learner export. We have no record of a production change originating from our documented Northstar connector node 10.10.4.12. We are reviewing whether a credential or configuration was exposed.

subject: Credential review request
body: Please confirm the credential identifier, approved source networks, permissions, and last rotation date for the production integration. Do not send the secret value by email.
